disclaimer: Screening estimates only; not a financial forecast, legal assessment, or deployment approval.

use_cases.title: Service request routing
use_cases.problem: Requests arrive through several channels and are manually assigned
use_cases.dependencies: Consistent request categories and a documented escalation path
use_cases.rationale: Impact 4/5; data readiness 4/5; feasibility 4/5; risk 2/5. Human review is included in the proposal.

use_cases.title: Knowledge article discovery
use_cases.problem: Staff spend time searching a large internal knowledge base
use_cases.dependencies: Permission-aware search index and current source articles
use_cases.rationale: Impact 4/5; data readiness 3/5; feasibility 4/5; risk 3/5. Human review is included in the proposal.

use_cases.title: Appointment reminder prioritization
use_cases.problem: Staff cannot easily identify appointments with a high no-show likelihood
use_cases.dependencies: Historical attendance data and a human-approved contact policy
use_cases.rationale: Impact 3/5; data readiness 3/5; feasibility 3/5; risk 3/5. Human review is included in the proposal.

use_cases.title: Duplicate case detection
use_cases.problem: Similar cases are opened repeatedly across teams
use_cases.dependencies: Stable identifiers and a review queue for possible matches
use_cases.rationale: Impact 3/5; data readiness 2/5; feasibility 3/5; risk 4/5. Human review is included in the proposal.
